title: Commons - PTSD and Disability Benefits
author: John Rigler
status: Unsigned AI-assisted research and editorial draft; no independent clinical or legal review recorded
scope: One adult-focused PTSD entry covering assessment, Social Security listing and work standards, functional evidence, treatment gaps, and the separate VA compensation system

articles.title: PTSD, functional limitations, and disability benefits

sources.description: National Institute of Mental Health, Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder. Civilian and military experiences, symptom groups, clinical assessment, and duration of symptoms.
SSA, SSI Eligibility, 2026 edition. Adult and childhood disability definitions, duration, financial conditions, and other requirements.
SSA, How Does Someone Become Eligible?. SSDI insurance/work conditions and the sequential disability evaluation, including work-related steps after the listings.

SSA, Adult Mental Disorders, listing 12.15 and sections 12.00C–G. Required medical findings, the alternative A+B and A+C routes, functional severity, sustained functioning, support, and marginal adjustment.
SSA, Evidentiary Requirements. Establishing a medically determinable impairment and evaluating severity with medical and nonmedical evidence.

SSA, SSR 16-3p, Evaluation of Symptoms in Disability Claims. Effective 28 March 2016, revised in 2017; symptom evaluation and consideration of reasons for limited treatment. Rules addressing failure to follow prescribed treatment are a separate issue.
SSA, Medical Evidence. Do not delay filing for records; agency evidence requests and possible examinations at agency expense.
SSA, Information for Military & Veterans: SSDI and VA Disability comparison. Different definitions, military-service conditions, work standards, and separate applications.
VA, Disability Compensation for PTSD. PTSD diagnosis and connection to an in-service traumatic event; specific eligibility and claim requirements.
VA, About Disability Ratings. The rating system, evidence, examinations, and compensation rates.

research_scope.clinical: NIMH explains PTSD and clinical assessment in civilian and military populations; no individual diagnosis is offered
research_scope.social_security: Adult duration and work rules, SSA listing 12.15 alternatives A+B and A+C, medical and functional evidence, and symptom evaluation under SSR 16-3p
research_scope.veterans_affairs: VA service-connected compensation and ratings are separate from SSA eligibility; no award is treated as automatically controlling another agency
research_scope.analysis: Application burden and proposed evidence organization are editorial analysis; procedural difficulty alone does not establish deliberate exclusion
research_scope.privacy: Public reusable explanation; personal clinical and trauma records remain outside this collection

publication.state: Public reading edition and prepared ledger reference

ledger_preparation.state: Unsigned draft; funding, fees, signing, pinning, and broadcast not performed
